decision: Owner gave a standing mandate: profit is the explicit goal (growing the balance or preventing losses, same goal), AIDY must become a full evidence-scored decision layer that knows each signal group's behaviour, can approve/deny/close-early/hold signals with explained reasoning, and must be continuously measurable on whether its decisions actually helped. Owner authorizes Claude to make routine engineering and product decisions without asking first, to propose costed spend up to roughly EUR200/month beyond existing ~EUR500/month costs, and to build new infrastructure (dashboards, databases, services) as needed. Full text pinned at OWNER_MANDATE.md so it does not need repeating. The one boundary this does not touch: AIDY's live-money/broker execution authority stays OFF and the 1% live-risk directive does not change silently -- both already stood as AGENTS.md rules before this mandate and remain in force, restated explicitly so 'full access to everything' is never later misread as having quietly overridden them.

AIDY's strategic destination is a full point-in-time Gold specialist, not merely a provider scorer. Build claim-grounded reasoning, a qualified Gold-state dossier, breaking-news/event intelligence, liquidity/execution intelligence, conditional provider alpha decomposition, regime-matched historical analogue memory, calibrated probability/expected-value decisions, profit-extraction management research, failure attribution/UNKNOWN handling, and continuous self-critique/ablation. Every provider-specific rationale claim must be addressable to exact PIT evidence; unsupported claims are forbidden. News is context rather than an automatic directional command. AIDY must explain abnormal Gold moves and trade failures when evidence supports a mechanism, and explicitly say UNKNOWN when it does not. The two-repo boundary remains hard: Aidy-Gold-Signals owns market/research intelligence, Super Signals owns provider/broker execution, and exchange happens only through versioned PIT-safe contracts. Live-money authority remains OFF until each decision class independently passes prospective counterfactual/calibration/adversarial gates and receives explicit owner approval.
reason: Owner explicitly wants AIDY to know why Gold moves, why trades fail, when liquidity matters, how to maximise winner extraction, how historical regimes match, and when each provider is conditionally strong; the live reasoning audit also proved unsupported provider-history claims must be technically impossible rather than merely discouraged.

decision: Replace long-term reliance on coarse single-rule Gold gates with a staged expert-gate architecture. Freeze a factorised global Gold environment first; give each gate a specialist mini-environment; score gate and sub-calculator reliability separately by environment with small-sample shrinkage and hierarchical backoff; penalise duplicated/correlated evidence; keep context-only gates non-directional where appropriate; preserve UNKNOWN/ABSTAIN; and require sequential build/test/acceptance before moving to the next gate. Current simple 15-minute gates remain the legacy baseline until new gates prove incremental out-of-sample value.
reason: Owner explicitly requires each gate to be intelligent within itself and wants AIDY to know the current environment, consult historical gate reliability for comparable environments, and weight the strongest relevant gates rather than learning from simplistic candle-direction rules.
